targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. The route starts a short way left of the Late Show pedestal, on the left side of a small roof leading into a left-facing corner crack.
targets.descent_text: Descent is by lowering or rappelling from the bolted anchors. Climbed as one linked pitch the descent takes two lowers or rappels.
targets.name: Hidden Treasure

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. The route lies between Hidden Treasure and the Late Show, starting at the right side of a small roof a little above head height.
targets.descent_text: The route ends at the first-pitch anchor of Hidden Treasure. Routes on this wall are lowered from their fixed anchors.
targets.name: Land of the Unknown

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. This is the third route from the right on Da Bub Wall and begins on the stone patio immediately to the left of Wunderbub.
targets.name: Maine's Finest Athlete

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. The route starts on the shady terrace behind the hemlocks at the far left end of the wall, before the fixed hand line.
targets.descent_text: The route ends at chains. Routes on this wall are lowered from their fixed anchors.
targets.name: Ole man's booty

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. The route lies between Hidden Treasure and the Late Show. It starts at the right side of a small roof a little above head height, climbing the line of Land of the Unknown before continuing up and left to the finger crack high on the wall.
targets.name: Stoned Off the Unknown

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. Start by following the first few bolts of The Late Show, then move left toward Hidden Treasure; other starts also exist.
targets.descent_text: The second pitch ends at chains. Routes on this wall are lowered from their fixed anchors.
targets.name: Turnbuckles to Talus

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. Tut's Crack is the crack right of Farewell Angelina and is reached by starting up High-Dollar Hounds or Farewell Angelina, or by a traverse in from the far-left end via The Late Show.
targets.name: Tut's Crack

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. The route begins on the hemlock terrace toward its right end, in the gap between the corner of Old Kids on the Rock (left) and that of Hidden Treasure (right).
targets.descent_text: From the top, a lower goes directly to the next rappel station.
targets.name: Uncommon Ground

targets.approach: From the parking lot at the former Old Man site in Franconia Notch, take the Greenleaf Trail, which climbs toward the AMC Greenleaf Hut. A little before Eagle Pass, once the grade eases, a small cairn on your left marks a climbers' path heading steeply up. Bear left at each split, staying under the trees and clear of the talus field to the right. All Right Flank routes start from a grassy ledge reached at the far right side of the wall, where Luck of the Green is the first climb met. I'll Lead That is a short way left of Wet Shoes Sound Mind, beginning from a brushy ledge beneath one bolt.
targets.descent_text: The route ends at a fixed anchor, and routes on this wall are lowered from their anchors.
targets.name: I'll Lead That
Star Trek Slab's Left-Side Route (Mid-Cliff Start)

targets.approach: Start from the rescue cache on the floor of Tuckerman Ravine and bushwhack across, keeping the Remi Bourdage memorial boulder on your left. Work over the boulder field to the clear gully left of Lion's Head (as you face it) and follow it up to the height of a small gendarme-shaped feature. A short bushwhack then contours to the foot of that feature and an obvious launch pad where the climbing starts.
targets.descent_text: The route ends just below the summit of Lion's Head. From there walk down the Lion's Head Trail, which is the trail you are standing on.
targets.name: Lion's Head Standard

targets.approach: The Upper Face sits above the huge tree ledge on Mt. Willard and is normally reached by climbing one of the Main Face routes. Thor is toward the right-hand end of the upper tier, a short way left of Salespitch. The start is easy to recognize by a homemade bolt just above the ground, under a large beech and on top of a pointed rock.
targets.descent_text: The Upper Face is descended by the hiking path down to the road, so park with that in mind.
targets.name: Thor

targets.approach: Buttress 3 is the last of the Boott Spur Buttresses, the right-most one seen from the far side of Tuckerman Ravine. Hike the Boott Spur Trail and leave it before the Boott Spur summit to traverse in to the base of the buttresses.
targets.name: Buttress 3

targets.approach: Park at the Cannon Tramway, walk through the tunnel and follow the Greenleaf Trail to a cairn, then take the approach gully used for the Eaglet and Flatiron. At the talus field bear left, as you would for the Flatiron. Close to the bottom of the last approach slab, a path falls away left beyond a big boulder to the base of a short buttress, which is climbed at easy fifth class, followed by a short bulge. Move back right past loose blocks to the lone bolt that starts Route 66, the first route on the wall.
targets.descent_text: Rappel from the two-bolt anchor on top of the buttress.
targets.name: Route 66

targets.approach: Billings Fold is the sunny slab directly below the summit of Mount Monadnock, off the Smiths Summit Trail. The traverse starts up Stemming Corner.
targets.descent_text: At the end of the wall, either top out or downclimb the gully, which is somewhat awkward.
targets.name: Billing’s Fold Traverse

targets.approach: Follow the paved path from the parking area at the north end of Cannon Cliff to the large boulder on the right that has a sign across the trail; swing around it through the trees and climb the talus to the Moby Grape routes. The route takes the clear chimney at the right-hand edge of the Moby buttress.
targets.name: Right Side of the Moby Buttress

targets.approach: Follow the paved path from the parking area at the north end of Cannon Cliff to the large boulder on the right that has a sign across the trail; swing around it through the trees and climb the talus to the Moby Grape routes. Tip Corner is the clear left-facing corner just left of Tip Trip.
targets.name: Tip Corner

targets.approach: Follow the paved path from the parking area at the north end of Cannon Cliff to the large boulder on the right that has a sign across the trail; swing around it through the trees and climb the talus to the Moby Grape routes. Unblocked starts on the featured slab immediately right of the standard crack start of Vertigo, below a finger crack.
targets.descent_text: Climbed on its own, stop before the right-facing dihedral and walk off left at fourth class.
targets.name: Unblocked
